# IINA Magnet Anime4K Plugin Notice

The IINA runtime, host integration, managed installer, integrity checks, and
maintenance controls in this directory are an independent IINA Magnet
implementation. They do not copy the runtime implementation of the community
plugin `com.yorkyang2333.anime4k`.

The sidebar visual hierarchy and styling were adapted on 2026-07-14 from the
community project `yorkyang2333/iina-anime4k`, pinned at commit
`a416d4c669f4136006e5a9bbe3d27dcf64471bbd`. The adapted UI is modified for
IINA Magnet's Quality selector, managed diagnostics, repair controls, and
shortcut editor.

Copyright (c) 2026 IINA Magnet contributors. The integration and adapted UI
code are licensed under GNU GPL version 3; see `LICENSE`.

The bundled shader files are an allow-listed subset of Anime4K. Twelve shader
files remain under Anime4K's MIT license. The two AutoDownscalePre shader files
retain their upstream public-domain dedication under the SPDX `Unlicense`
identifier. See `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`,
`licenses/Anime4K-LICENSE.txt`, and
`licenses/AutoDownscale-Unlicense-NOTICE.txt`.
